title: Processing the Payload Prefix or Suffix
statement: For either choice of the program parameter, every bit string $r$, and every natural number $n$, the program on input $r$, starting at its head label with register value $n$ and input position $0$, reaches a halted state with register value $n-|r|$ truncated at zero. Its final input position is $�\min(n,|r|)$ when the parameter is true and $|r|$ when it is false; it appends the first $n$ bits of $r$ when the parameter is true and the suffix of $r$ after its first $n$ bits when false. The run takes at most $4|r|+3$ steps, for every output string already printed.
hypotheses_covered: The program parameter is a Boolean choice
The input is the arbitrary bit string $r$
The input position starts at zero
